meta.title: Add runtime rate target config
meta.body_summary: Add RuntimeConfig with rate_target_hz, propagate through CuConfig and CuRuntime, enforce in generated run loop, and showcase in cu_rate_target example.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit feature adding runtime rate target config; no review, no benchmark; merged by maintainer/agent user with low friction.

core_change_summary.description: Added RuntimeConfig with rate_target_hz field, propagated through CuConfig and CuRuntime, and enforced in the generated run loop via cu29_derive macro; added a cu_rate_target example demonstrating end-to-end usage.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The new example showcases the rate target feature with a config file, build script, and main loop that prints at the target rate.
